defs.def: a container that you put waste in 垃圾箱

ex.s: B: I would go up to them and ask them to put the litter into a rubbish bin.
ex.t: B：我会走上前去，让他们把垃圾放进垃圾桶里。

ex.s: There is evidence that urban racoons are more intelligent than their wild cousins, as they frequently have to figure out difficult problems such as how to open rubbish bins and other containers which they would not find in the wild.
ex.t: 有证据表明，城市浣熊比它们野外的同类更聪明，因为它们经常需要解决一些难题，比如如何打开垃圾桶和其他在野外找不到的容器。

ex.s: Liu Bin, a member of the camp, says that he is to help Mount Tai as people have done for more than 3,000 years.
ex.t: 营地成员刘斌说，他要像三千多年来人们所做的那样，去守护泰山。

ex.s: So, if people want to smoke, they should dispose of the butts properly in a rubbish bin.
ex.t: 所以，如果人们想吸烟，就应该把烟蒂妥善地扔进垃圾桶里。

ex.s: Make sure your seat belts (securely) and all carry-on luggage underneath the seats in front of you or in the overhead bins.
ex.t: 确保你的安全带（securely 系好），所有随身行李放在你前面座位底下或头顶行李舱里。
